sm_top.sm: Missiles hit Aden airport while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile headed for Yanbu.
Houthi drone and missile attacks targeting Riyadh airport and surrounding areas resulted in casualties, including deaths and injuries, prompting intercept efforts and security resp
Drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea left sailors missing, prompting NATO to deploy additional surveillance assets to the region.
Drone attack on Shaybah oil field killed 3 workers and injured 10.
Russian drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, including a strike near the North Bridge in Kyiv, resulted in at least four deaths.
Sudan denied responsibility for a drone strike on a market in Abyei that killed at least 153 people.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in multiple Palestinian deaths and injuries.
Two men were re-arrested in the UK for assisting Iranian intelligence in a suspected arson plot targeting RAF Fairford.
Iran reported that oil tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz.
The US and Israel are reportedly drawing up plans to resume attacks on Iran following the upcoming US election.
Escalating fighting in Yemen has displaced over 233,000 people and caused a severe humanitarian and hunger crisis.
Houthi militias committed 109 violations and crimes over 48 hours in Taiz, including missile and mortar attacks that killed two civilians.
Russian airstrikes hit apartment blocks in Sloviansk, killing six people and leaving others trapped under rubble.
Poland scrambled fighter jets in response to Russian strikes in western Ukraine.
Ukrainian forces conducted drone strikes against Moscow and a weapons facility in Serpukhov.
Yemeni military forces report ongoing airstrikes against Houthi fighters, with varying casualty figures reported over recent days.
The Kremlin warned Germany of new attacks after an attempt to blow up a Ukrainian aircraft in Leipzig.
At least 40 civilians were killed in northern Mali following attacks attributed to the Islamic State.
The Saudi coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone launched toward Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
The U.S. is deploying additional warships and Marines to the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran.
Houthi drone and missile attacks targeted King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and nearby Saudi infrastructure, resulting in multiple deaths.
A Russian missile strike on a market in Lozova killed two people and caused a DTEK power plant to stop generating electricity.
Drone strikes on a market in a disputed Sudanese town left more than 150 people dead.
Hospitals in El Fasher, Sudan, were deliberately targeted in multiple attacks, resulting in numerous health worker deaths.
Russian missiles pounded Kyiv.
Sudan denied responsibility for a drone strike on Amiet Market in Abyei that reportedly killed 220 people.
Israel conducted strikes in southern Lebanon, killing 4,386 people, while a drone was observed flying over Beirut.
The IRGC has threatened to cut undersea internet cables in the Persian Gulf and target oil and AI facilities.
A funeral was held in Shabwah for about 75 security personnel killed in a Houthi missile attack.
Ukraine reports 176 Russian drones launched, with 140 intercepted or suppressed, causing damage to a power plant and strikes in occupied Luhansk.
Aerial and drone attacks in Sudan continue to cause civilian casualties and harm.
Russian MoD claims drone strikes hit the Novokyivska substation in Hotiv, the Zhytomyrska substation in Zhytomyr, and two dry cargo ships.
The Gaza death toll from Israeli operations rises to 74,498, with over 175,000 injured.
An attack on buses in northern Niger leaves 12 people dead.
Houthis strike Saudi-led coalition targets after Saudi airstrikes across Yemen killed eight fishermen.
A drone strike damaged eight of twelve storage tanks at the Novoshakhtinsk Oil Products Plant.
Russian Ministry of Defence claimed its forces carried out three massive and 11 group strikes hitting Ukrainian military-industrial enterprises, energy infrastructure, and drone st
The WHO reports at least 1,500 people killed in renewed fighting in Yemen.
Houthi drone and missile attacks targeted a Saudi airport and oil hub, causing fires and casualties.
The Russian MoD reported intercepting hundreds of Ukrainian drones across multiple regions.
